notes: Seeds are the independent units. With three seeds (df = 2) the 95 % t interval is 4.30 standard errors (2.48 standard deviations of the paired differences) on each side; with five seeds (stage 3, df = 4) 2.78 standard errors.
std_over_seeds is variability across independently trained models; mean_test_sample_std is the spread of the per-sample error over the 256 test samples for one model. They are different quantities.
Holm adjustment within each family, on the overall error only. Only the G2 and G4 primary and the G5/G6 primary family are confirmatory.
effect_size_dz = mean / sd of the paired differences over three seeds; unstable, reported for completeness.
The test-sample bootstrap intervals hold the trained models fixed and do not include seed variability.
